Stack: React 18 + Vite + TypeScript + Tailwind + shadcn/ui + Supabase + React Query + Framer Motion. Never use `any` type.

## Task: Sprint 6B — In-App Notifications

Migration `013_growth_features.sql` already exists with `notifications` table (id, user_id, type, title, body, link, read_at, created_at).

### Read these files first:
- `src/types/index.ts` — current types
- `src/types/database.ts` — DB type patterns
- `src/components/TopBar.tsx` — FULL file, where notification bell goes
- `supabase/functions/analyze-url/index.ts` — last 100 lines, where to create scan-complete notification
- `src/hooks/use-billing.ts` — hook pattern

### 1. Types

**`src/types/index.ts`** — Add:
```typescript
export interface AppNotification {
  id: string;
  user_id: string;
  type: 'scan_complete' | 'score_improved' | 'score_dropped' | 'team_invite' | 'finding_reappeared' | 'system';
  title: string;
  body: string | null;
  link: string | null;
  read_at: string | null;
  created_at: string;
}
```

**`src/types/database.ts`** — Add `NotificationRow` type and table to Database interface.

### 2. Notification Hook

**Create `src/hooks/use-notifications.ts`:**
- `useNotifications()` — fetches last 20 notifications for current user, ordered by created_at DESC
- `useUnreadCount()` — returns count of notifications where read_at IS NULL
- `useMarkRead(notificationId)` — mutation: update set read_at = NOW()
- `useMarkAllRead()` — mutation: update all unread for user
- `useDismissNotification(id)` — mutation: delete notification

### 3. Notification Bell Component

**Create `src/components/shared/NotificationBell.tsx`:**
- Bell icon (Bell from lucide-react) in a button
- Red badge with unread count (hidden if 0)
- Click opens a Popover (from shadcn/ui) showing notification list
- Popover content:
  - Header: "Notifications" + "Mark all read" button (text link)
  - Scrollable list (max-height 400px) of NotificationItem components
  - Empty state: "No notifications yet"
  - Footer: link to see all (future, for now just the list)
- Popover auto-closes when clicking a notification link

**Create `src/components/shared/NotificationItem.tsx`:**
- Props: `notification: AppNotification; onMarkRead: (id: string) => void`
- Layout: icon (by type) + title + body (truncated) + time ago + unread dot
- Icon mapping: scan_complete → ScanLine, score_improved → TrendingUp, score_dropped → TrendingDown, team_invite → Users, system → Info
- Unread: blue dot indicator, slightly bolder text
- Click: if has link, navigate to link + mark as read. If no link, just mark as read.
- Time formatting: "2m ago", "1h ago", "3d ago" (simple relative time, no library needed)
- Use framer-motion for entrance animation (stagger)

### 4. Integrate into TopBar

**Modify `src/components/TopBar.tsx`:**
- Import NotificationBell
- Add NotificationBell next to the user avatar dropdown (left of avatar)
- Only show for authenticated users

### 5. Create Notifications from Scan Pipeline

**Modify `supabase/functions/analyze-url/index.ts`:**
- After scan is marked "completed" (near the end, alongside Slack/webhook triggers), insert a notification:
```typescript
// Non-fatal notification creation
try {
  await supabaseAdmin.from("notifications").insert({
    user_id: userId,
    type: "scan_complete",
    title: "Scan Complete",
    body: `Your audit of ${scanUrl} scored ${overallScore}/100`,
    link: `/reports/${scanId}`,
  });
} catch (err) {
  console.warn("Notification insert failed:", err);
}
```

- If the scan has a previous scan for the same URL (from scan_history), compare scores:
  - If score improved by 5+: insert `score_improved` notification: "Score improved! {url} went from {old} to {new}"
  - If score dropped by 5+: insert `score_dropped` notification: "Score dropped: {url} went from {old} to {new}"

### Requirements:
- No `any` types
- Notifications are created server-side (edge function), read/dismissed client-side
- Bell badge shows unread count, clears on mark-read
- Relative time formatting without external libraries
- Popover is mobile-friendly (full-width on small screens)
- Follow existing component patterns (Card, Button, Popover from shadcn/ui)
- Framer Motion for staggered list entrance

**`src/hooks/use-notifications.ts`** — Four hooks: `useNotifications` (fetches last 20, ordered newest first), `useUnreadCount` (derived from query cache, no extra fetch), `useMarkRead` (single notification), `useMarkAllRead` (bulk), `useDismissNotification` (delete). All invalidate the same query key on success.

**`src/components/shared/NotificationItem.tsx`** — Per-notification row with type-specific icon + color, relative time (`2m ago` / `1h ago` / `3d ago`) computed inline, unread dot, framer-motion entrance animation, click navigates + marks read.

**`src/components/shared/NotificationBell.tsx`** — Bell button with live unread badge, shadcn `Popover`, staggered `AnimatePresence` list, skeleton loading state, empty state, "Mark all read" text button in header, mobile-friendly width (`min(380px, 100vw - 2rem)`).

**`src/components/TopBar.tsx`** — Static notification `DropdownMenu` replaced with `<NotificationBell />` (shown only when `profile` is truthy). Dead imports (`Bell`, `Settings`, `DropdownMenuSeparator`, `DropdownMenuLabel`) removed.

**`supabase/functions/analyze-url/index.ts`** — Step 14 added after webhook dispatch: inserts `scan_complete` notification always; queries `scan_history` for previous score on same URL; inserts `score_improved` if delta ≥ +5, `score_dropped` if delta ≤ −5. All wrapped in try/catch — non-fatal.
